# Twitter / X — 2026

Spreadsheet originals are four moltbook/MOGZART posts through April 7. The live scrape from June onward is the AI-tooling year the sample synthesis already named: Fable 5 fourteen-hour runs, Grok Build piracy-prompt crackdown the same day as Claude godmode, VST installs, 'Hi tom!,' DnB AOTY locks, and the quote-tweet politics of late August. This page will keep moving.
